decision.name: SEPARATE_PUBLIC_PRODUCER_ATOMICITY_FROM_UNAVAILABLE_REAL_CONSUMER_ACCEPTANCE
decision.finding: The exact public tree has 65 entries and no identifiable real production consumer for the three output JSON files. runner.run_once persists latest.json, audit_latest.json and anata_latest.json through three separate atomic_write_json calls; storage.atomic_write_json atomically replaces only one file. Therefore a raw-read pause test is a valid producer negative control, NOT production-reader acceptance. This is a source-level risk, not an observed production incident.

tightened_no_network_contract.source: Pinned two-writer A-20261014-378cffe-two-writer-generation-test-1557.json plus same-clock economic-oracle and A-20261027-d4ac647-1559-single-writer-reader-window.json
tightened_no_network_contract.producer_gate: Create two PIT-visible economically distinct A/B archives at identical as_of_ms; assert normalized economic evidence fingerprints differ for each of latest/audit/handoff (exclude collection_attempts, filesystem paths, generated timestamps). Start A and pause immediately after latest.json atomic replace; complete B on same local_dir; release A. Require final three files to correspond entirely to A or entirely to B; mixed A/B is a failing producer acceptance, not a PASS. Repeat with single paused writer and raw JSON reads as expected mixed-window negative control; never count raw-reader result as production consumer proof.
tightened_no_network_contract.consumer_gate: Only if an explicitly authorized real production consumer path is identified, invoke that exact offline consumer against the same paused-writer fixture; accept coherent A or coherent B or explicit retry/fail-closed, reject mixed output. Public synthetic readers are insufficient. No production consumer identified in the 65-entry public tree; consumer gate NOT_RUN/UNAVAILABLE.
tightened_no_network_contract.required_evidence: Exact repo SHA, test blob hashes, command stdout/stderr and exit codes; no assertion of pass without execution.

decision.why_no_new_task: Gemini JSON reliability UNVERIFIED, proposed writer regression test not materialized/executed, and public-only test cannot validate unavailable production consumer. No malformed task replay.
